title: Cross-Pack Extension, Patch Hook & Conflict Detection
objective: Define explicit extension points and bounded overlays for one pack to integrate with another without destructive whole-object replacement. Detect competing patches, incompatible assumptions and ordering conflicts before activation; preserve source/package provenance for every applied extension.

scope.purpose: Provide explicit cross-pack extension points, bounded overlays and pre-activation conflict detection without destructive whole-object replacement.
scope.completion_gate: Cross-pack extensions remain bounded and provenance-preserving, destructive whole-object replacement is rejected, and competing patches, incompatible assumptions and ordering conflicts are detected before activation.

selection_boundaries: CNI-08 is completed_verified before CNI-09 implementation.
CNI-09 may define extension and overlay compatibility semantics but may not create a new canonical owner-domain state authority.
Whole-object destructive replacement remains outside the approved cross-pack extension model.
Source/package provenance must be preserved for every applied extension and conflicts must be surfaced before activation.
CNI-09 analyzes explicit pack/component/extension metadata only; it performs no pack activation, owner-domain mutation or hidden patch-ledger persistence.
CNI-10+, PCA and SMB-08 remain unauthorized.
PCA remains eligible but unselected and unauthorized.

implementation_plan.red: Add a focused CNI-09 acceptance and Validation Core profile proving explicit extension points, bounded overlays, provenance preservation, rejection of destructive replacement, and deterministic pre-activation detection of competing patches, incompatible assumptions and ordering conflicts before production implementation exists.
implementation_plan.green: Implement the minimum deterministic extension-plan compiler/conflict analyzer over explicit pack/component/extension metadata. It returns a bounded compatibility plan or fail-closed conflicts without applying overlays, mutating owner state, resolving localization or activating packs.
implementation_plan.proof: Add CNI-09 compliance evidence, governance boundary documentation and source-governance verifier; then exact-head Linux/Windows profile validation, client typecheck and deterministic cross-platform comparison.
implementation_plan.closeout: Merge only the exact validated application head, verify validated tree equals merge tree, then OPS3-close CNI-09 and select only the roadmap-permitted successor.

next_action: Establish causal RED before production implementation.
